name: user_requests_employment_letter_with_recent_joining_date
goal: User who joined recently requests an employment letter.
constraints: Employee details must be present. Joining date is within the last 7 days.

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options, including recent joining date.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot proceeds to trigger mail workflow silently.

phases.description: Bot triggers mail and confirms success.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the exact confirmation message for employment letter request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
